bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
cd "$root"
test -f scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py && test ! -L scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py || exit 60
test -f scripts/userbot_link_photo_caption_smoke.py || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 62
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 63
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-photo-resident-route.XXXXXXXX)"
cp scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py "$tmp/old.py"
python3 - "$tmp/old.py" "$tmp/new.py" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import ast,sys
source=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
if "link_photo_caption_smoke" in source:raise SystemExit(70)
if "ACTIONS = frozenset(" not in source:raise SystemExit(71)
begin=source.index("ACTIONS = frozenset(")
position=source.find('"link_rich_flow_smoke"',begin)
if position<0 or position>source.index("\n",begin):raise SystemExit(72)
source=source[:position]+'"link_photo_caption_smoke", '+source[position:]
needle='    if action == "link_rich_flow_smoke":'
if source.count(needle)!=1:raise SystemExit(73)
branch='    if action == "link_photo_caption_smoke":\n        from userbot_link_photo_caption_smoke import run\n        return {"request_id": request_id, **await run(client)}\n'
source=source.replace(needle,branch+needle,1)
compile(source,str(sys.argv[2]),"exec")
Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(source,encoding="utf-8")
PY
swapped=0
ok=0
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$swapped" = 1 && test "$ok" != 1; then
  cp "$tmp/old.py" "$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" || true
  systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || true
 fi
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
cp "$tmp/new.py" scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
swapped=1
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 74
git fetch --no-tags origin chat/link-button-master-final-20261120 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 75
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 9483f0c7f73644a6258a15610b5a3fd23b5e56f0 || exit 76
git show FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_test_client.py > "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" || exit 77
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 15); do
 if test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active && PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=1; break;fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" = 1 || exit 78
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 79
ok=1
echo PHOTO_RESIDENT_ACTION_ROUTE=PASS
echo USERBOT_SESSION_HEALTH=PASS
echo ORIGINAL_LOCAL_IPC_RETAINED_EXCEPT_NARROW_ROUTE=PASS
